carrier_event = {
	id = colony_automation_event.21
	hide_window = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_plan_build_new_zone
        NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_zone }
	}

	immediate = {

                if = {
                    limit = {

                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_missile_silos
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_missile_silos
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_missile_silos }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_ammunition_lines
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_ammunition_lines
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_ammunition_lines }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_laser_capacitors
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_laser_capacitors
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_laser_capacitors }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_flight_decks
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_flight_decks
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_flight_decks }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_passenger
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_passenger
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_forever_cruise_passenger }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_shipwright
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_shipwright
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_shipwright }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_crew
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_crew
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_forever_cruise_crew }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_passenger
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_passenger
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_passenger }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_crew
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_crew
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_crew }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_mixed
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_mixed
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_forever_cruise_city_mixed }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_zones_of_zone_ark_sacred_path_pilgrims
                            value > value:num_zone_plan_of_zone_ark_sacred_path_pilgrims
                        }
                    }
                    remove_zone = { zone = zone_ark_sacred_path_pilgrims }
                }
    }
}

# trigger by on_zone_complete
# remove zone flag if construction completed
carrier_event = {
	id = colony_automation_event.12
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes
	trigger = {
		owner = {
			is_ai = no
		}
	}
	immediate = {
        remove_all_zone_plan_flag = yes
	}
}

# synchronize configured zone selections with built zones
carrier_event = {
	id = colony_automation_event.22
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes

	immediate = {
		bca_sync_primary_zone_selection_if_overplanned = yes
		bca_sync_secondary_zone_selection_if_overplanned = yes
	}
}

# enable zone auto-destruction and unlock all zone selectors
carrier_event = {
	id = colony_automation_event.23
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes

	immediate = {
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_zone
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z1
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z2
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z3
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z4
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z5
		remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_zx
	}
}

# disable zone auto-destruction, close selectors, and lock matched slots
carrier_event = {
	id = colony_automation_event.24
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes

	immediate = {
		clear_open_selector = yes
		set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_zone
		carrier_event = { id = colony_automation_event.22 }
	}
}
